claim: Empire.exe contains none of the 20 Napoleon-only effect names (the new tag, the 16 new attribute names, ribbon.fx, unit_dust_parameters and unit_dust_parameters.txt) as ASCII or UTF-16LE, while Napoleon.exe contains all 20 (attribute names and the tag as UTF-16LE, ribbon.fx and the dust file name as ASCII); the method finds all 118 tag and attribute names both games' definitions share in both exes (controls). Empire's parser therefore has no name for them; whether it ignores an unknown attribute or tag or rejects the file is open (an Empire launch, D11)
